title: Aceh Tamiang Flood Context Review, November 2026
processing: Filter local HDX ADM3 features where adm2_name is Aceh Tamiang; select report-named subdistricts using an explicit fixed name list.
limitations: This is not an emergency-warning system.
This is not a flood-extent map.
This does not estimate water depth, damage, or response priority.
Highlighted polygons are administrative areas named in a dated report.
An area not highlighted was not named in this report snapshot and may still have been affected.
Administrative boundaries are reference geometry and do not trace the edge of floodwater.
Boundary geometry is from a 2020 HDX administrative-boundary release and is used as reference context, not an authoritative legal boundary determination.
Terrain relief is a general reference context derived from a Copernicus digital surface model and is not flood evidence.

terrain_relief.role: Reference terrain context, not flood evidence.
terrain_relief.source_version: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, COG 10 degree tiles
terrain_relief.attribution: Produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
terrain_relief.processing: Web Mercator reprojection at 100 m pixels, then GDAL multidirectional hillshade with compute_edges; PNG display scale 32-220.

satellite_reference.role: Optional reference imagery, not event-date flood evidence.
satellite_reference.acknowledgement: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
